Incumbent [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] Governor [[Nikki Haley]] ran for a second term in office. She faced [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] State Senator [[Vincent Sheheen]] in the general election. Republican-turned-independent [[Tom Ervin]] had been running, but he withdrew from the race and endorsed Sheheen. Haley defeated Sheheen for the second time, winning with nearly 56 percent of the vote.{{Cite web |url=http://www.thestate.com/2014/11/09/3801867/democratic-nominee-for-2018-its.html |title = Democratic nominee for 2018?
